svg.title: Straight tube segment with mirrored right-handed and left-handed helical lane families
svg.desc: Paper-style schematic of a straight tube section carrying 12 right-handed and 12 left-handed shallow helical lanes. Only the surface-visible lane portions are drawn; hidden backside lanes are omitted for clarity.
svg.text: Only the surface-visible portions of the helical lanes are drawn. Occluded backside lanes are intentionally omitted.
